extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: This policy establishes Humana's billing requirements and reimbursement for hemoglobin A1c laboratory services.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for individuals with a diagnosis of either Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes once every three months.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE once every 365 days to help in the detection and diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes in individuals aged 18 and over with any of the following:

reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for individuals with a diagnosis of either Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes once every three months.

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE once every 365 days to help in the detection and diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes in individuals aged 18 and over with any of the following:

High-risk race/ethnicity (e.g., African American, Latino or Hispanics, Native American, Asian American, Pacific Islanders) at risk for Type 2 diabetes (e.g., obesity)

Other clinical conditions associated with insulin resistance (e.g., acanthosis nigricans)

Diabetes screening with a hemoglobin A1c determination (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE once every 3 years for children aged 10-17 with at least one of the following characteristics:

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for pregnant individuals up to once per month during pregnancy.

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE when billed in conjunction with measurement of (CPT code 82985) fructosamine.
